datasets_evaluated.evidence: We have used the publicly available CIRA-CIC-DoHBrw-2020 dataset for developing an accurate solution to detect and classify the DNS over HTTPS attacks.

label_source.evidence: For experimenting, we have used the publicly available CIRA-CIC-DoHBrw-2020 dataset[8] from the Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity (CIC).
